PowerOneLineOne: Fire a shot of charged Digi-Soul from your fist to attack an enemy.
PowerOneLineTwo: This does 3 damage, and if you can roll Soulful Fist an extra 3 damage
PowerOneLineThree: if you beat the target's defense.
PowerTwoLineOne: Any time this scene you would take analogue damage instead you
PowerTwoLineTwo: will take 3 damage per Bruise, 6 per Injury, and 9 per Wound.
PowerThreeLineOne: Near instantly move to another place in the current scene provided
PowerThreeLineTwo: you are on the same floor as it. If you are not on the same floor
PowerThreeLineThree: then you can take the chance of using Mega Lunge. If you haven't used
PowerThreeLineFour: your tamer action last turn you can use this once to intercept an attack.
